f4e7f2b9-9baf-488c-a0f9-e0f4d44fb0b3.title: Zatsuyo-gakari to Shite Yado de Hataraki Hajimeta Renkinjutsu-shi, Kanbanmusume-tachi to Issho ni Kurasu Koto ni Natta
f4e7f2b9-9baf-488c-a0f9-e0f4d44fb0b3.altTitle: An Alchemist Who Started Working as a Handyman at an Inn Ends Up Living with the Inn's Lovely Girls
f4e7f2b9-9baf-488c-a0f9-e0f4d44fb0b3.description:
In the quiet countryside stands Yadorigi, an old inn with a nostalgic charm.

Roji, a young man who works there as an all-purpose handyman, has a secret no one knows: in his previous life, he was a legendary alchemist.

Grateful to the late benefactor who once took him in, Roji has been secretly using alchemy to help the inn's three beautiful sisters, who are the face of Yadorigi. But one stormy night, disaster strikes—his own dilapidated home is blown away without a trace!

With nowhere else to go, Roji is at a loss until the three sisters offer him an unexpected solution:

"If you've got nowhere to stay, why not live here at the inn?!"

And so begins Roji's life under one roof with the three sisters: a caring and dependable eldest sister, a tsundere middle sister who struggles to express her feelings, and a carefree youngest sister.

bdb9b841-bbca-490e-b8b8-efb6f0fde943.title: Meitantei Holmes: Bijo to Houken
bdb9b841-bbca-490e-b8b8-efb6f0fde943.altTitle: Sherlock Hound: The Beautiful Woman and the Sacred Sword
bdb9b841-bbca-490e-b8b8-efb6f0fde943.description:
A special promotional spin-off manga/story booklet bundled exclusively as an appendix ("furoku") with the February 1985 issue of Animage magazine. Created by veteran animator and character designer Hatsuki Tsuji, who served as a key animation director on the "Sherlock Hound" television anime series.

The story follows Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson embarking on an original investigation to unravel the mystery of a legendary sacred blade and protect a lady while contending with the machinations of Professor Moriarty.

Takes place after "The Missing Bride Affair" from the anime series.

f25227dd-e163-4a6d-9b79-c6b04e984ac4.title: When a Genius Office Worker Goes Too Far
f25227dd-e163-4a6d-9b79-c6b04e984ac4.description:
A genius marketer from Korea’s top film company, the only employee ever to fail peer evaluations, and the company’s public enemy number one for being caught up in a bribery scandal.

These labels sum up Han-rok’s life as a corporate employee. All he ever wanted was to focus on his work. 

But his refusal to play politics or suck up to anyone his decision to avoid aligning with any faction - came back to bite him in the form of betrayal and false accusations.

Just when he hit rock bottom, He found himself back on that day, five years ago, when everything began to unravel.

Determined never to be a victim again, Han-rok starts to cross the line. And for the first time, He begins to see the threads of the real problem that had always been hidden.
